[[Rollerbeetle Racing (outpost)|Rollerbeetle Racing]] is the staging area for the [[Rollerbeetle Racing|Rollerbeetle race]]. All players in the outpost are under the effect of the [[Rollerbeetle Racer]] [[disguise]].

==Getting there==
Characters access the outpost by talking to the [[Rollerbeetle Trainer]] during any [[Shing Jea Boardwalk]] event and for one week after [[Canthan New Year]] in [[Great Temple of Balthazar]], [[Lion's Arch]], [[Shing Jea Monastery]], and [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]]. 

==Exits==
To exit the area, talk to the [[Rollerbeetle Master]].

==Notes==
*Unlike most areas, mouse clicking does not initiate movement here.
*While in this outpost during the week after Canthan New Year has ended, nothing happens when clicking "Enter Battle"; however, players do have access to the [[#Services|services]] provided here.
